Lemma
Source: chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0067, chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0068 1. Lemma 2.39\group neckpinch

The scale-invariant quantity \[ \hat F=\frac{K}{L}\bigl[\log L+2-\log L_{\min }(0)\bigr] \] satisfies $\sup _{\mathcal W(t)}\hat F\le \max \{ n-1,\sup _{\mathcal W(0)}\hat F\} $.
